newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Robertson Stephens starts Rambus.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Robertson Stephens starts Rambus.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co said analyst Dan Niles initiated coverage of Rambus Inc with a buy rating.
-- said Rambus is the pioneer in developing high speed DRAM (dynamic random access memory) solutions.
-- said expects Rambus to earn $0.20 a share in fiscal 1998 and $0.45 a share in fiscal 1999.
-- said "We believe that the earnings upside is explosive, especially by the year 2000 .... we believe the DRAM market will be roughly $50 billion by 2000 versus $25 billion in 1996."
